requirement_text.ISS-0297:
Two distinct root causes confirmed by ISSUE-FIXER (step-01 PASS):
1. EngineConcurrencyTest (@instance_count 100) exhausts pool_size=5 at N=16. The test needs pool_size >= 100, impossible at any N >= 2 on 100-max_connections Postgres.
2. AuditIssueClosuresTest processes 201 docs/issues/*.yaml files with System.cmd per closed issue, hits ExUnit 60s default timeout under 16-way CPU load.

task.description:
Implement the fix for ISS-0297 on branch feature/WF03-ISS0297-20260826.

## Fix 1: EngineConcurrencyTest -- exclude from high-N parallel runs

Add `@moduletag :high_pool_demand` to the module declaration in test/letflow/engine_concurrency_test.exs. This tag signals that the test requires pool_size >= @instance_count (100 connections) and cannot run in partitioned mode on a standard 100-max_connections Postgres.

Update scripts/test_parallel.sh to pass `--exclude high_pool_demand` to each partition's `mix test` invocation when the computed pool_size < 100. Specifically:
- After the pool_size is computed/set (around line 164-166 in test_parallel.sh), add a check: if pool_size < 100, set EXCLUDE_HIGH_POOL_DEMAND='--exclude high_pool_demand', else EXCLUDE_HIGH_POOL_DEMAND=''
- Then pass $EXCLUDE_HIGH_POOL_DEMAND to each partition's mix test invocation

Add a comment in test/letflow/engine_concurrency_test.exs near the `@instance_count 100` line explaining WHY the tag is there and what pool_size is required.

Also update docs/migration/decisions/0009-test-parallel-pool-sizing.md (if it exists) to document this known test class. Read it first to see if it needs updating.

## Fix 2: AuditIssueClosuresTest -- extend timeout

Add `@moduletag timeout: 120_000` at the module level in test/mix/tasks/letflow.audit_issue_closures_test.exs. This gives the test 2 minutes instead of ExUnit's default 60 seconds, which is sufficient for the 201-file corpus scan even under parallel load.

Add a comment explaining the extended timeout: the test calls Audit.run([]) against the real docs/issues/ corpus (currently 201 files) and spawns System.cmd per closed issue via a fake gh binary -- under high-parallelism CPU contention this can exceed the default 60s.

## Verification
After implementing:
1. Run `mix test test/letflow/engine_concurrency_test.exs` (standalone) -- must pass
2. Run `mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow.audit_issue_closures_test.exs` (standalone) -- must pass
3. Run `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -- must pass
4. Quote actual output

Do NOT run the full 16-way parallel suite -- that would take too long and isn't needed to confirm the fix. The next step (TEST-RUNNER) handles broader coverage.

## Scope boundary
Do NOT:
- Change @instance_count (it must stay 100 for the test to be meaningful)
- Change the test assertions
- Change config/test.exs pool_size formula
- Change docs/migration/decisions/0009 unless a factual update is needed
acceptance_criteria: scripts/test_parallel.sh passes --exclude high_pool_demand to each partition when pool_size < 100
mix test test/letflow/engine_concurrency_test.exs passes standalone with real output quoted
